title: Planets and Rashi, Part 1
sub: Complete notes on Jyotish Vidya Ep. 8 (Part 1) by Brajesh Gautam, The Anchor Of Life. Houses versus signs, planetary speed, the twelve signs, the Sun, Moon and Mars sign by sign, and remedies.
desc: Complete notes on Jyotish Vidya Ep. 8 (Part 1), Planets and Rashi, by Brajesh Gautam: how houses and signs differ, how fast each planet moves, the Sun, Moon and Mars through the twelve signs, donation rules and gemstone caution, with video timestamps.
points: The 12 houses are like fixed rooms. Planets move through the 12 signs at very different speeds, from the Moon's 2.5 days to decades for Indra, Varuna and Yama.
Own sign is strong, a friendly sign can beat it, the opposite sign is weakest.
This one rule runs through every planet-by-sign reading in the class.
The Sun, Moon and Mars change meaning sign by sign.
Light, water and fire each react differently to each sign's own element, from best to debilitated.
Mercury is good almost everywhere, with one weak spot.
Debilitated in Pisces. Remedy: never disrespect a sister, aunt, daughter or sister-in-law, and serve the hijda community.
Donation only works if it matches the actual placement.
A well-placed planet's items, given at a sacred place, multiply fortune. The same items given around a badly placed planet can make things worse.
Shade, origin, finger and weight are chart-specific. Getting the weight wrong, in either direction, can backfire.
Test an astrologer or a guru before trusting them.
Let them tell you things unprompted. Once you run out of questions for someone, they have earned the title.
